text:
joel: Launching: Air-gapped Installer Beta + Compliance Pack v2.1 for Private deployments. Target: select pilot customers (air-gapped/air-gapped+HSM). Docs and installer image pushed to artifact registry: https://internal.redwood.io/airgap/v2.1. Please read and flag blockers.
infra-bot: Artifact push complete: redwood-airgap:v2.1 1778200456 by joel
rachel: Big win 1 this includes the new offline license activation flow? we need PTO steps for field engs.
joel: Yes 1 offline activation via signed license blob and per-install nonce. See "license-activation" section in docs. Example command: 
```bash
./airgap-installer activate-license --blob license.sig --nonce 0xA12F
```
tony: Compliance ask: we've bundled SOC2 templates + PCI checklist into the pack? customers asked for audit-ready evidence steps.
priya: Confirmed 1 added SOC2 mapping for onprem controls and sample evidence artifacts (retention proof, snapshot hashes, attestation). Also added a PCI scoping doc for customers that want cardholder data segregation.
marta: Legal: we've added a required export-control acknowledgement for customers in restricted jurisdictions. Will follow up with copy changes for the onboarding UI.
joel: Note on HSM: airgap supports PKCS#11 modules and also local file-backed testing mode for pilots (NOT for production). Docs warn: file-backed keys are non-compliant.
infra-bot: Preflight checks updated: disk-space, entropy pool, kernel modules, and a local HSM simulation flag. See installer output example: 
```
PRECHECK: OK disk=120G, entropy=high, pkcs11=found
WARNING: HSM-sim enabled (non-prod only)
```
rachel: Can field engs get a slide deck + 10-min demo? Sales asked for a one-page security summary for prospects.
joel: I'll coordinate with doc-maintainers. Posting a 2-slide summary and demo script to sales-assets by EOD.
tony: Operational change: audit-forwarding now supports batched delivery to an on-prem SIEM via TLS client-auth. Config snippet: 
```yaml
siem:
  host: 10.0.0.5
  port: 6514
  tls:
    client_cert: /etc/redwood/certs/client.crt
    client_key: /etc/redwood/certs/client.key
  batch_interval_seconds: 15
```
priya: Security policy update: for air-gapped GA we require documented key-rotation cadence and proof uploaded to the customer's runbook. We'll enforce via onboarding checklist.
marta: Legal reminder: EU privacy addendum needed if any telemetry is enabled during enablement. Default for airgap = telemetry disabled; explicit opt-in only.
infra-bot: Installer CI: airgap e2e started 1 build #513, smoke tests queued.
rachel: Scheduling: pilot enablement calls next Tue/Wed. Can field engs volunteer for live installs? prefer morning slots.
joel: Volunteers: rachel, tony, priya for initial three installs. I'll add invites.
legal-bot: New clause draft for onboarding UI uploaded to legal repo 1 review by marta required.
priya: One more: telemetry-off mode will emit a deterministic diagnostic bundle that customers can choose to send to support manually. Details in troubleshooting.
joel: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Docs: finalize activation & HSM guidelines (rachel), 2) Security: confirm rotation checklist (priya), 3) Legal: finalize EU copy & export clause (marta), 4) Sales: get security one-pager (joel). Post progress here. :rocket:
